variants.zh: "一心多体，包罗宇宙间的空旷寂寥。”
variants.en: "One mind in many, encompassing the vast coldness of space."

variants.zh: “初步分析——已完成，系统——运行中。单元已准备指派。”
variants.en: "Preliminary analysis - complete. Systems - nominal. Unit ready for assignment."

variants.zh: “新枝舒展，众志所引。同心共进，生生不息。”
variants.en: "A new branch unfurls, guided by the will of the whole. Together, we grow."

variants.zh: “我将贯彻您的信念，为您带来胜利！”
variants.en: "Give me your faith and I shall give you victory!"

variants.zh: “科学家的梦想就是造福社会。”
variants.en: "The dream of the scientist is to benefit society."
"Respect your crew, and you will have victory."

variants.zh: “我们将为了所有人的福祉并肩作战。”
variants.en: "We shall fight side by side for the good of all."

variants.zh: “每位公民都值得发声，而我立志成为倾听者。”
variants.en: "Every citizen deserves a voice, and I aim to listen."

variants.zh: “天才和疯子之间只隔着成功与否。”
variants.en: "The difference between insanity and genius is success."

variants.zh: “最好的进攻就是坚不可摧的防御。”
variants.en: "The best offense is an impenetrable defense."

variants.zh: “在我的指挥下，战争不是野蛮行为的借口。”
variants.en: "Under my command, war is no excuse for savagery."
"Science is the mirror of the divine."

variants.zh: “无论敌人有多么强大，我们的精神必将屹立不倒。”
variants.en: "No matter how formidable the enemy, our spirit will not falter."

variants.zh: “能理解魂灵之力的才是最好的领袖。”
variants.en: "The best leaders are those who understand the power of the spirit."

variants.zh: “我已经准备好将我的理论付诸实践。”
variants.en: "I'm ready to put my theories into practice."

variants.zh: “我们的舰队将如恒星般强大！”

variants.en: "A well-equipped army is a victorious army!"

variants.zh: “我的三个首要目标：规划、生产、繁荣。”
variants.en: "I have three priorities: planning, production, and prosperity."

variants.zh: “让我们去探索新星球，推进未知的边界！”
variants.en: "Let's discover new worlds and expand our frontiers!"
"Understanding the enemy is the first step to victory."

variants.zh: “多样化能够保障社群的健康。”
“我们必须赶上外界的步调才能保障繁荣。”
variants.en: "To prosper, we must keep pace with the outsiders."
"No xeno will stand in our way."

variants.zh: “我将毫不留情地对待敌人和它们的领袖。”
variants.en: "I will give our enemies no quarter, their leaders no mercy."

variants.zh: “我会确保我们的行星高产而纯粹。”
variants.en: "Our planets must remain pure and productive."

default.zh: 我们的征途是星辰大海。

variants.zh: §G范格利牌双层床§!！这些创新的、节约空间的、可折叠的“休眠插座”能提升星球的居住容纳量，让你可以每平米“挤进”更多的人！
variants.en: §GTrium-brand bunk beds§!! These innovative, space-efficient, stackable "rest receptacles" increase the habitation potential of planetary housing, allowing you to "squeeze in" more capita per square meter!

variants.zh:
§G范格利牌食品容器§!！你是否厌倦了殖民地人民任由各种蔬果生鲜慢慢腐烂，仅因为他们的消化系统一时难以负担？

把这个容器空投到你选的殖民地，它可以收集各种各样的食物，并且持续保鲜。有了它就完全不用担心食品浪费的问题，因为它可以将食品通通保存起来，不但解决了食品浪费，也解决了食品需求的问题。
variants.en:
§GTrium-brand food storage containers§!! Is your administration tired of colonists letting perfectly digestible vegetable or animal matter decompose in their domiciles because their digestive systems can only process so much input at a time?

Air-dropped onto a colony of your choice, these semi-transparent, lidded containers hermetically seal cooked or raw foods, keeping the contents fresh for longer. This is the perfect way to preserve leftovers as delicious and/or nominally nutritious snacks for later, dramatically reducing food waste and, ergo, food needs.

variants.zh:
§G范格利牌大气层除臭器§!！你的农耕地盘是不是闻起来臭臭的？你的大都市是不是闻起来“拜托，不要了！”你的殖民地§E恶臭吗§!？

交给我们就好了，我们的气雾剂与微生物混合的专利产品能够清理所有宜居对流层。坐好，放松，安上我们的除臭器，清新空气自然来。
variants.en:
a §GTrium-brand atmospheric deodorizer§!! Do your agri-worlds smell like fertilizer? Is your ecumenopolis more like a "yuck, ew, no please?" Does your colony §Estink§!?

We have the solution! Our patented blend of microbes and aerosol reagents will clear the air of any habitable troposphere. Just sit back, relax, deploy the strato-drones, and enjoy the fresh air.

variants.zh: 上好的§G范格利小玩意收藏套装§!！这里面全是时尚艳丽的小玩意儿，肯定会让你成为全场瞩目的焦点。

variants.zh: 齐心协力，我们将更加富强。“我们”当然是指[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]。
variants.en: Together we grow stronger. 'We' meaning of course the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName].

variants.zh: 你当然明白。毕竟我们确确实实赢了。
variants.en: Surely you understand. We did win, after all.

variants.zh: 这样，整个联邦将从我们的共同努力中受益。
variants.en: This way the entire Federation will benefit from our joint effort.

variants.zh: 很明显，如果要公平地分配这些财富，我们必须亲自动手。
variants.en: It's evident that if this wealth is to be fairly distributed, we must do it ourselves.

variants.zh: 贪婪对任何人都没有好处。
variants.en: Being greedy will not help anyone.

variants.zh: 恳请你，收下吧。我们不希望承担这尘世财富的重担。
variants.en: Please, take it. We wish not to carry the burden of mundane riches.

variants.zh: 也许这可以让你看到生活的真正价值，而不是盲目地盯着毫无意义的数字和金条。
variants.en: May this allow you to see the true value of life, rather than staring blindly at pointless numbers and bars.

variants.zh: 这将创建一个更强大，更统一的联邦。
variants.en: This will create a stronger and more unified Federation.

variants.zh: 既然已经清楚了谁是领袖，请随意使用你的财富，只要你觉得合适。

variants.zh: 我们将利用这些财富让我们更强大，并惠及联邦全体。
variants.en: We will use this wealth to strengthen ourselves, and in effect the whole Federation.

variants.zh: 你当然明白。毕竟我们确确实实赢了。

variants.zh: 给吧。没有必要为此争斗下去。

variants.zh:
一股悄无声息的狂潮席卷了我们的人民。其起源何处已经无从追索，尽管其中§H虚境§!的影响确定五一。我们正在经历启示，认定我们[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]命中注定成就伟大事业。我们应该调查是什么造成了这样的群体性癔症，以及耳边低语着的统治星海的允诺。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
variants.en:
A quiet mania sweeps through our population. Its origin seems intangible, although the influence of the §HShroud§! is unmistakable. We experience ongoing revelations that we [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are destined for greater things. We should investigate the cause of this mass hysteria, and its whispered promises of galactic domination.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

variants.zh:
遍布[Root.GetName]多个恒星系的传感器传来十分微弱、但是完全无法解释的能量涨落。这些能量异常现象十分微小，并不足以扰乱我们的进程，但是我们仍然授权进一步调查以确保我们了解事情的起因。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
variants.en:
Sensors in multiple systems across the [Root.GetName] report minuscule, but inexplicable, energy fluctuations. These power anomalies are too small to disturb our processes, but they still warrant further investigation so as to ascertain their cause.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

variants.zh:
我们的无人机网络内感测到了异乎寻常的冲动——一种迫切的想要成为更加伟大存在的追求。一种囊括整个星系的思维。尽管这种追求不来源于我们内部，但其承诺的前景如此诱人，让我们没法置之不顾。谨慎的做法是，我们要专心致志地寻找这些侵入性动机的根源。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
variants.en:
We have sensed alien impulses within our drone networks - an undisciplined desire to grow, to become greater still. One Mind to encompass the entire galaxy. It is not of us, but its promise is too tempting to ignore. It is prudent that we prioritize finding the origin of these intrusive impulses.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

variants.zh:
已知，我们所居住的物理宇宙和§H虚境§!是相连的，一个位面发生的大规模扰动事件或行动会对另一个位面产生“涟漪效应”。

我们影响这些事件的结果到何种程度，已成为科学部门的新研究焦点。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
variants.en:
As we know, the physical universe we inhabit and the §HShroud§! are linked, with particularly disruptive events causing ripple effects that resonate from one dimension to the other.

The full extent to which we can influence the outcome of these events has become the new focus of research for our science divisions.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

variants.zh:
我们的数据库已证实，当前所居住的物理宇宙和§H虚境§!是相连的，一个位面发生的大规模扰动事件或行动会对另一个位面产生“涟漪效应”。

我们影响这些事件的结果到何种程度已经成了首要的研究任务。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
variants.en:
As our datasets have proven, the physical universe we inhabit and the §HShroud§! are causally linked, with repeated instances of disruptive events cascading from one dimension to the other.

The full extent to which we can influence these outcomes has become a priority research task.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

default.zh:
我们的[root.GetResearcherPlural]重复地观测到当前宇宙与§H虚境§!的连接。我们能与这些存在位面最多能交互到何种程度值得研究。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
default.en:
Our [root.GetResearcherPlural] have repeatedly observed connections between this realm and the §HShroud§!. The full extent to which we can interact with these layers of reality is worth exploration.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

variants.zh:
随着我们星系的地位逐渐提高，§H虚境§!成为我们军火库的一种驱动力。意志薄弱者将继续失败，而我们会加强与那个超出他们理解的力量间的联系。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
variants.en:
As we strengthen our position in the galaxy, the §HShroud§! is a driving force in our arsenal. Those of a lesser consciousness will continue to fail, as we bolster our connection to a power beyond their comprehension.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

default.zh:
我们的意识还在延展，与§H虚境§!的联系也在随之与日俱增。在面对我们的的持续演化，一个迟滞、破碎的星系毫无可能战胜我们的伟大联合。

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$
default.en:
Our mind continues to expand, and our connection to the §HShroud§! along with it. In the face of our continued evolution, a stagnant, disconnected galaxy stands no chance against our great union.

$CRISIS_SPECIAL_PROJECTS_TUTORIAL$

variants.zh: 在司令部的冲突达到顶点后，似乎民主派已经击退了他们的对手，因为他们控制了我们的许多中心学院。
variants.en: After the conflict came to a head in the admiralty itself, it seems the democratic faction has beaten back their opponents, as they take control of many of our central faculties.

variants.zh: 在司令部自身的冲突达到顶点后，似乎寡头派在酝酿中的冲突中取得了胜利，因为我们所有殖民地都在广泛宣布这一消息。
variants.en: After the conflict came to a head in the admiralty itself, it seems the oligarchic faction has taken the victory in the brewing conflict, as a widespread announcement is shared across all our colonies.

variants.zh: 在一切尽在掌控之中的情况下，民主派的指挥官们对他们的老对手进行了一场短暂的伪审判，然后把他们当作帝国的叛徒公开处决。
variants.en: With everything under their control, the democratic commanders bring their old rivals through a short mock prosecution, before they are publicly executed as traitors to our empire.

variants.zh: 在一切尽在掌控之中的情况下，民主派的指挥官们对他们的老对手进行了一场短暂的伪审判，然后征收巨额罚款后释放了他们。
variants.en: With everything under their control, the democratic commanders bring their old rivals through a short mock prosecution, but most of them are released after receiving strict fines.

variants.zh: 尽管一切都在民主派的掌控之中，他们的老对手却在混乱中消失了。没过多久，我们就收到了分裂主义运动在司令部许多老成员中不断发展的报告。
variants.en: Though everything is under democratic control, their old rivals disappeared in the chaos. It does not take long before we receive reports of a growing separatist movement around many of the old members of the admiralty.

variants.zh: 在发表公开声明之后，他们紧接着发表了一篇演讲，谴责他们的对手是煽动者、民粹主义者和卖国贼。势力最强的民主分子很快被处死，其余人则从公众视野中消失了。
variants.en: After making their public announcement, it is followed by a speech denouncing their rivals as rabble-rousers, populists, and traitors. The strongest democratic elements are quickly put to death, with the rest disappearing from public view.

variants.zh: 在发表公开声明之后，他们紧接着发表了一篇演讲，谴责他们的老对手。他们都被处以重罚，并被采取措施确保再也不会成为麻烦。
variants.en: After making their public announcement, it is followed by a speech denouncing their old rivals. They are all heavily fined, and steps are taken to make sure they will never be a nuisance again.

variants.zh: 在发表公开声明之后，他们对老对手的追捕很快就开始了，但毫无效果。在司令部办公室的混乱斗争之后，民主派几乎消失了。
variants.en: After making their public announcement, the hunt for their old rivals quickly ensues, but to no avail. The democratic elements have all but disappeared after the chaos of the fight in the offices of the admiralty.

variants.zh: 在除掉他们的对手后不久，他们决定将他们自己的政府政策强加给我们的帝国。
variants.en: Shortly after getting rid of their opponents, they decide that they will impose their own government policies on our empire.

variants.zh: 虽然他们已经除掉了他们的对手，并接管了我们的帝国，但似乎他们很乐意让事情像往常一样继续下去——至少现在是这样。
variants.en: Though they have gotten rid of their opponents, and have taken charge of our empire, it seems they are happy to let things continue as normal - for now.

variants.zh: 随着他们的对手离去，他们决定不仅要把自己的政策强加给我们的政府，而且还要让他们的老领袖亲自领导。
variants.en: With their opponents gone, they decide that they are going to not only impose their own policies on our government, but also that their old leader is going to take personal charge of leading it.

variants.zh: 他们在目标地点遇到了一艘坠毁的舰船残骸，仍然在不时地向外发送微弱的信号。
variants.en: They came across the debris of a ship which had crashed at the location, still sending out weak signals every now and then.

variants.zh: 他们找到了一座在轨的古老采矿站，似乎在很久以前就被其拥有者抛弃了。
variants.en: They found an old mining station in orbit, seemingly abandoned by their owners a long time ago.

variants.zh: 追逐微弱信号之旅带领着他们来到了一处空置的小型哨站，然而周边迹象显示某个技术水平和我们不相上下的存在新近在此地出现过。
variants.en: The hunt for the weak signal led them to a small empty outpost, yet there were signs that someone of a similar technological level to our own had been there fairly recently.

variants.zh: 在信标地址周边满是散落的船壳和其他垃圾，经判断肯定是某时刻来自于一个一度存在过的大型恒星基地——然而没有任何迹象表明附近有这样一个结构存在。
variants.en: All across the signal beacon site were pieces of hull and other detritus which must have come from a larger starbase at one point - yet no other signs of such a structure remain.

variants.zh: 当他们搜索地址周边区域的时候，设法找到了一个看上去像是空救生舱的东西，里面还有一个未知的、外星生命体的残骸。他们打算尽可能快地将样品带回做进一步测试。
variants.en: As they searched through the site, they managed to find a seemingly vacant lifepod with what looked like it the remains of an unknown, alien lifeform. They will bring the sample back for further tests as soon as they can.

variants.zh: 我们之前捕捉到的信号读数来源于一台仍然以某种方式运转的机器，我们的小队设法从机器中提取到了一些有关制造它的文明的文件。由于我们先前对这个文明不甚了解，我们将其纳入了数据库——尽管他们看上去来自于一个更加古老的纪元。
variants.en: One of the machines responsible for the signals we had picked up on was still somewhat operable, and our team managed to extract some files about the civilization it supposedly hails from. As they are previously unknown to us they will be entered into our databases - though they seem to be from a much older era.

variants.zh: 尽管当地了无感性生命迹象，此地仍然是很多动物的繁育之地，而且这些动物看上去学会了使用破损的机械作为求爱展示的道具。我们的小队将会带回其中一部分以作进一步的留观。
variants.en: Though uninhabited by sentient beings, it is the breeding grounds for a group of animals, who have seemingly learned to use some of the broken machinery as part of their courtship display. Our team will bring some of them back to be monitored further.

variants.zh: 看上去当地的野生动物使用了部分内部机械作为它们求爱展示的道具。尽管我们通常对于这些动物毫无兴趣，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]还是将这些有趣生物的一部分带回作后续的留观。
variants.en: It seems the local wildlife have started using the machinery from the interior as part of their courtship display. Though usually of little interest to us, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] will bring some of these curious beings back to be monitored further.

variants.zh: 当他们对当前区域进行筛选的时候，他们遇到了一座小型图书馆，里面满是记载了各种当地动物的生物学细节的书籍，这些书籍来自许多原定居者曾经造访过的行星。我们的小队将会带回这些书籍，并开始破解书中使用的语言，并且将其中提取到的一切信息添加到我们的数据库。
variants.en: As they sifted through the area, they came across a small library with books they think detail the biology of various local fauna, from the many different planets the original inhabitants had visited. Our team will bring them back and start deciphering the language used in the books, and add whatever information they can glean from them to our own databases.

variants.zh: 在对该地点执行彻底搜寻之后，我们发现了一处图书馆。其中的书籍详尽地介绍了几千种外星植物的生物学细节，标本来自于原居住者造访过的每一个星球。我们会将这些书籍带回改善我们的数据库。
variants.en: After scouring the location, we discovered a small library. The books inside detailed the biology of thousands of exo-fauna, specimens from each of the planets the original inhabitants visited. These will be brought back to improve our own database.

variants.zh: 尽管没有剩下什么有用的东西，我们的小队还是找到了一些记载不同行星的地质活动的研究论文——至少根据上面的图画，他们自己是这么认为的。他们会将自己认为能够抢救的一切资料带回，然后尽可能快地对其进行破解。
variants.en: Though not much of use was left behind, our team managed to find some research papers on geological activity from different planets - or at least so they think, based on the illustrations. They will bring everything they think can survive the journey back, to be deciphered as soon as possible.

variants.zh: 尽管没有剩下什么有用的材料，我们的工程无人机还是定位到了一些记载不同行星的地质活动的研究论文。能够抢救的一切资料将会被带回，然后尽可能快地对其进行破解。
variants.en: Though very few useful materials were left behind, our engineering drones did locate some research papers on geological activity from different planets. Everything that can survive the journey back will be returned, and deciphered as soon as possible.

variants.zh: 我们的小队花了大量的时间试图攻破那个尚在运转的机器的防御，结果发现它们里面什么有用的东西都没有。不过，机器本身激起了他们的好奇心，他们会带一些部件回来。
variants.en: Our team spent a significant amount of time trying to crack the defenses on those machines which are still active, only to find they contained nothing of real interest. The machines themselves have piqued their interest though, and they will bring some parts back.

variants.zh: 我们投入了非常多的时间攻破那个发送信号的机器，现在可以肯定它藏有什么秘密尚未重见天日。无论我们能够回收什么部件，都会在第一时间将其带回。
variants.en: After devoting a considerable amount of time to crack the defenses of the machines responsible for the signals, we now believe they may hold secrets yet to be divulged. Whatever parts we can salvage will be brought back right away.

variants.zh: 他们发现一台可能制造了围绕该区域的薄弱屏障的机器——这可能是我们最初能找到这些东西的唯一原因。其他的东西一文不值，他们花了一些时间进行了拆解以期有所发现。
variants.en: They found a small machine which seems to be responsible for a weak barrier surrounding the area - probably the only reason there's anything to be found in the first place. With nothing else of value there, they have spent their time picking it apart, to see what they can learn from it.

variants.zh: 尽管缺乏保养或维护，但似乎有一台此前用于支持此处参与设施的聚变反应堆仍在继续运行。我们的小队对此特别感兴趣，并将对其进行进一步调查。
variants.en: It seems a fusion reactor was keeping what was left of the place still running, in spite of a lack of care or maintenance. Our team have taken a special interest in it, and will investigate it further.

variants.zh: 尽管缺乏必要的维护，有一台此前用于支持此处参与设施的聚变反应堆仍在继续运行。我们的工程子个体将对其进行进一步调查，以期能有所发现。
variants.en: An old fusion reactor was keeping what was left of the place still running, in spite of the lack of necessary maintenance. Our engineering drones will investigate it further to see if there is anything we can learn from it.

variants.zh: 当我们的专家在此处的废墟中梳理时，他们找到了一些几乎完好无损的舰船部件。虽然在长久的年岁中劣化失效，但我们的工程师相信他们可以从中筛选出一些信息
variants.en: When they were combing through the ruins of the place, our specialists managed to find some mostly intact ship parts. Though no longer functional due to degradation over time, our engineers believe they can sift some information from them.

variants.zh: 在梳理废墟时，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一些舰船部件。尽管由于长期劣化而不堪使用，但我们相信还是可以从中筛选出一些信息。
variants.en: As we combed the ruins, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came upon several ship parts. Though no longer functional due to degradation over time, we believe we can sift some information from the pieces.

variants.zh: 尽管此处颇为荒凉，我们的专家们还是发现了一些前所未见的建筑材料。他们完成发掘和分析工作之后，样品将会送回进行进一步测试。
variants.en: Though it is somewhat desolate, our specialists have found several uses of a building material they have never seen before. When they have finished their excavations and analysis of the area, samples will be brought back for further testing.

variants.zh: 我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一件我们此前从未见过的建筑材料。尽管应该无法直接使用，但我们可以将其带回去进行进一步分析。
variants.en: Our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] have come upon a building material unlike any we have ever seen before. Though it is unlikely that it can be of use to us, it will be brought back to be analyzed further.

variants.zh: 尽管没有在此处发现任何感性生物，我们的发掘人员还是在往深处挖掘时发现了一些无人机。它们已经严重受损，难以完整地进行逆向工程，但我们的技术人员相信这些分散的部件仍能给我们提供新的建造科技。
variants.en: Though there are no sentient beings to be found, our excavators found several drones when they dug a bit deeper. Though they are damaged beyond the point of being able to be reverse-engineered in their totality, our technicians believe their disparate parts might teach us new building techniques.

variants.zh: 我们的发掘[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]发现了一些与我们自身集体意识底层相似的信号，再稍微深挖之后发现了两台老旧损坏的自动机器人。尽管损伤已经无法修复，但我们相信通过对它们的部件进行逆向工程，我们还是能对它们的建造方式有更多了解。
variants.en: Our excavation [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came upon a signal similar to that which underlies our own shared consciousness, and after digging a bit deeper a pair of old broken automatons. Though damaged beyond repair, we believe we can reverse-engineer some of their parts to gain greater insight into how they once worked.

variants.zh: 在废墟中筛选时，他们发现了一个曾存放着材料的小金库残骸，现在空无一物——很可能是很久以前就被海盗偷走的了。然而，其中还留下了一些关于原始居民如何开采这些相同材料的蓝图，这可能会派上用场。
variants.en: As they were sifting through the ruins they found the remains of a small vault that once held materials, now empty - and most likely stolen by pirates, perhaps ages ago. They left behind some blueprints of how the original inhabitants had been mining these very same materials however, which might come in handy.

variants.zh: 尽管此处一片狼藉，我们的团队还是找到了一台完全没有被时间、野生动物或海盗所损伤的机器。它们相信只要能够尽快破译它，其中一定蕴含着能带来科学突破的秘密。
variants.en: Despite the damage done to the rest of the location, our team managed to find a machine entirely unscathed by time, wildlife, or pirates. They believe it might hold the secrets of a scientific breakthrough, as soon as they can decipher them.

variants.zh: 尽管此处其他部分七零八落，我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]还是发现了一台没有被时间、野生动物或海盗损坏的机器。只要能尽快破译它，我们就有希望能从中发掘出深埋的秘密。
variants.en: Though most of the location is falling apart, our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] managed to find a machine entirely unscathed by time, wildlife, or pirates. We hope that it might divulge some long forgotten secrets - once we manage to decipher it.

variants.zh: 就在我们的团队要离开这个区域时，他们发现了一小箱蓝图和研究论文。据我们的专家称，这些内容不但很容易破解，而且其中的一些甚至可以解决一些我们最近开展的研究中所遇到的难题。
variants.en: As they were about to leave the area, our team came across a cabinet of blueprints and research papers. Not only were they supposedly easy to decipher, but our specialists believe some of them might shine a light on some research we had only recently begun working on ourselves.

variants.zh: 就在我们的维护[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]要离开这个区域前，他们发现了一小箱蓝图和研究论文。这些内容不但很容易破解，而且我们相信其中的一些甚至可以解决一些我们最近开展的研究中所遇到的难题。
variants.en: As we looked through the area one last time, one of our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] came across a cabinet of blueprints and research papers. Not only were they easy to decipher, but we believe they might shine a light on some research we had only recently begun working on ourselves.

variants.zh: 就在[FromFromFrom.GetName]的地表之下我们发现了一处破旧的结构，因为时间的流逝被隐藏了起来。尽管它的结构某种程度上可以说完好无损，但是在建筑内部却没有什么值得回收的。不过，我们发现了一条通往地底更深处的通道。
variants.en: Just beneath the surface of [FromFromFrom.GetName] we found an dilapidated structure, hidden away by the passage of time. Though its framework remains somewhat intact, there is nothing worth salvaging inside the building itself. However, we have discovered a passage delving further underground.

variants.zh: 我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]找到了一群不知所措的小机器，它们仍在尝试完成设定的任务。这些机器聚集在一个被碎片和拆解的设备阻碍了的地点。主集线器已经下线并且基本失效，但有一个信号有规律地出现，明确地指引我们向地下探索。
variants.en: We found a group of smaller, bewildered machines at [FromFromFrom.GetName], still trying to execute their designated task. The machines were grouped together at a focal point blocked by debris and dismantled equipment. The main hub is offline and mostly useless, though a signal occurring at regular intervals and leading deeper underground has given us a clear direction to follow.

variants.zh: 我们此前对[FromFromFrom.GetName]的分析发现了一座位于地表上的坑洞附近的基础研究中心，通往一个巨大的地下洞穴。研究中心和其中的机械已经无法挽救，我们会着眼搜寻洞穴。
variants.en: Our early analysis of [FromFromFrom.GetName] uncovered a basic research center around a hole on the surface that led to a massive underground cavern. With the research center and its machinery entirely unsalvageable, we have refocused on surveying the cavern.

variants.zh: 对[FromFromFrom.GetName]地表进行详尽的调查后，我们发现了一个正在对该区域进行高密度扫描的探测器。无论我们做什么如何尝试交互，这个探测器都只会返回这一个地点继续原来的动作。依照它的行为模式，我们开始对地下的区域进行扫描。
variants.en: After an exhaustive survey of the surface of [FromFromFrom.GetName] we discovered a probe that was engaged in an intensive scan of the region. No matter what we do or how we try to interfere, the probe will inevitably return to that one spot to continue its operations. Following its pattern of behavior, we have begun to survey the ground beneath.

variants.zh: 我们在[FromFromFrom.GetName]发现了一座古老的采矿站或是研究站的废墟。似乎它是在过去的某一时候坠毁于此的。同时其上还有着受到攻击的迹象。尽管受到了严重的损伤，这座空间站仍然将信号向地下传输。在继续下一步之前，我们毫无疑问应该对此进行深究。
variants.en: We have come across an old and ruined mining or research station at [FromFromFrom.GetName]. It seems likely that this crashed to the surface at some point in the past. It also shows signs of having been attacked. Despite the extensive damage, the station is continuing to direct a signal underground. Before moving on, we should no doubt investigate this further.

variants.zh: 它似乎与一个流动在地表下来源不明的电流相连。更重要的是，我们无法确定电流会持续多久，是否稳定，但我们相信我们可以利用它。
variants.en: It seems to have been attached to an electric current running below the surface, the origin of which remains unclear.  What's more, we have no way to determine how long the current will last, or if it is entirely stable, but we believe we can make use of it.

variants.zh: 它似乎是为了维持一台古老的发电机运转而建造并隐藏在地表之下的。尽管存在很多设备问题，我们可以认定发电机仍运行良好。再费些功夫，我们应该就能够稳定它并为我们所用。
variants.en: It appears to have been built to keep an archaic generator alive and hidden just below the surface, and despite all the equipment problems one might expect the generator appears to be running fine. With some work, we should be able to stabilize it and make use of it ourselves.

variants.zh: 当进一步观察神秘的发电机时，我们发现它连接在几条贯穿[FromFromFrom.GetName]的大电缆上。整个大家伙似乎都是由一个位于地表以下的单一设备运行的。只需对电流稍作修改，我们就可以利用它产生的能量。
variants.en: When we looked further into the mysterious generator, we found it is attached to several large cables running throughout [FromFromFrom.GetName]. The whole thing seems to be run by a single apparatus housed far below the surface. With only a slight modification to the current, we can probably make use of the energy it creates.

variants.zh: 这台发电机连接到一处埋藏于底下的矿脉，其中可能蕴藏着对这台机器的运转者而言至关重要的原材料资源。尽管已经快要枯竭，我们仍可以将这些资源据为己有。
variants.en: The generator is attached to a mineral vein buried below ground, once probably an important source of raw material for whoever was in charge of the machine's operations. Though somewhat diminished, we can make use of these resources ourselves.

variants.zh: 进一步的探索发现这座发电机连接到了一处昏暗的、蕴藏着一些小型矿脉的人工洞穴。在地面上四处散布着一种此前未知的石质物种的尸体。目前还不清楚他们是在开采这些矿物，还是直接在地里开吃，但不管怎么样，他们身上密布的矿物突起对我们可能相当有使用价值。
variants.en: Further exploration revealed the generator is connected to a dim grotto complete with several smaller veins of minerals. Scattered about the floor were the bodies of a previously unknown lithoid species. It is unclear if they were harvesting the minerals or eating them straight from the ground, but in either case the bodies are encrusted with mineral protrusions that may well prove useful to us.

variants.zh: 这座发电机建立于一处巨大的地下洞穴中，填满了各种各样的矿物。很可能这整座巨大的洞穴就是被它自己给挖空的。它可能是出于对深入行星地壳的需求的结果而进行的挖掘。
variants.en: The generator is built within a gigantic underground chamber, filled to the brim with minerals of all kinds. Emptying the grotto is going to be an endeavor in itself. Digging is likely to result in the need to push deeper into the world's crust.

variants.zh: 对这片区域的进一步探索发现，它连接到一处似乎还在保持一定运转的远古设施。利用现有资源，这座机器继续在往外吐出锻造好的崭新而好用的合金锭。
variants.en: Further exploration of the area revealed it is connected to an ancient apparatus somehow still continuing its operations. Using the resources on hand, the machine continues to spit out well-forged and entirely pristine bricks of useful alloys.

variants.zh: 我们发现了一处奇怪的储存设施，其中塞满了支离破碎的舰船部件。尽管这些部件已经无可救药了，但我们可以把这些材料回收利用。
variants.en: We have uncovered an odd storage facility filled with battered ship parts. Though the parts themselves are unsalvageable, we could possibly reuse some of the materials.

variants.zh: 对这个区域的进一步调查发现了一处深藏于地下的机库。在库房里我们发现了一些已经残破不堪的舰船，上面丝毫找不到它们前主人的线索。恢复机库里的这些舰船相当困难，但我们应该可以抢救回一些对我们仍有用的部件。
variants.en: Extended surveys of the region led to the discovery of a hangar bay hidden deep below ground. Around the rooms we find several decayed ships, with no signs of whoever once owned them. Though recreating the ships that once stood in the hangar will be difficult, we should be able to salvage the parts for our own purposes.

variants.zh: 它看上去同一个采矿装置连接在一起，后者用于开采一种罕见的、古怪的晶体矿脉类型，尽管现场没有任何标识说明是谁在负责这个设施。在经过一些轻微的调整之后，我们能够将其为己所用。
variants.en: It seems to have been connected to the mining operations of an unusual and oddly off-putting type of crystal growth, though there is no sign of whoever must have been in charge of this facility. With some minor adjustments, we should be able to make use of it ourselves.

variants.zh: 它引向了一个人工洞穴，里面满是精妙的晶体生物——可能这里是某种地下农场或者放牧地。由于很久以前就遭废弃，这些生物仅凭自身意愿随意蔓延生长。由于他们看上去很友好好客，如果我们有意愿，可以将这个农场恢复正常运转。
variants.en: It led to a grotto teeming with delicate crystalline creatures - perhaps some sort of underground farm or breeding grounds. Long abandoned, the creatures are now free to roam as they wish. As they seem friendly and welcoming, we should be able to restore the farm if we so wish.

variants.zh: 紧接着，一个摇摇欲坠的矿井出现在面前，里面满是无人机仍然在应付墙上的晶状体隆起物。它们完全没有因我们的出现受到影响，依旧不断地将大型集装箱填满并放到一边。尽管大多数晶体都是随处可见的类型，基本没什么价值，但是我们在中间找到了一些非常稀有的品种。
variants.en: Following it revealed a rickety mine shaft filled with drones still hacking away at crystalline protrusions on the walls. Undisturbed by our presence, they worked continually to fill and set aside large crates. Though many of the crystals are common varieties and largely worthless, there are some rare ones to be found among them.

variants.zh: 沿着路继续向前，我们撞见了某种球状两栖生物的巢穴，其附近的空气中有一种奇怪的非自然粒子在不停地震荡。我们尚且不清楚为什么这些粒子对这种生物有着如此的吸引力，但我们相信只要投入一丁点工作，就能将这些粒子稳定并利用起来。
variants.en: Following it we come across the den of a bulbous amphibian creature, with vibrant, oddly unnatural particles vibrating through in the air around it. It is unclear why these particles are so attracted to the creature, but we believe that with a little work, we can stabilize and make use of them ourselves.

variants.zh: 随着我们继续探险，我们在更深处发现了一处紧凑的设施，其中有几个房间，里面的机器被放在一边用于稳定易爆微粒。尽管目前是安全的，这些机器很快就会达到亟需修理的临界状态；我们应当集中我们的努力将其恢复正常，以免这些机器工作到散架。
variants.en: As we continued our explorations, we discovered a compact facility further below, with several rooms and machines set aside for stabilizing volatile motes. Though safe for now, they will soon reach a critical stage of disrepair, and we should focus our efforts on restoring them before they fall apart.

variants.zh: 这个房室引导我们前往地下更深处，我们最终走到了一个人工洞穴，里面满是有毒的废料，慢慢地侵蚀着地面。尽管充满危险，但似乎这里就是我们先前发现的易爆微粒的来源。只要我们小心地执行稳定化流程，我们应当可以对此地加以利用。
variants.en: The chamber leading us further underground, we eventually came across a grotto filled with toxic waste, slowly eating away at the ground. Though dangerous, it seems to be the source of the volatile motes we discovered earlier. We should be able to make use of these, as long as we are careful with the stabilization process.

variants.zh: 由于某些原因，它似乎同某个埋在地下的废料处理站连接在了一起。这个站点十分古老，想要推测它的起源是不可能的事情，但我们相信可以收集一些这里的异星天然气为己所用。
variants.en: For some reason, it seems to be connected to a waste disposal site deep below the ground. The site is so ancient that it will likely prove impossible to speculate on its origins, but we believe we can harvest some of these toxic gases for our own purposes.

variants.zh: 它看上去同一个拥挤的研究设施连接在了一起，这个设施位于一个有毒天然气的自然产生点，气体不断地从[FromFromFrom.GetName]的地底喷涌而出。对这一设施进行重新调整应该可以让我们收集这一些气体为己所用。
variants.en: It seems to have been attached to a crowded research facility centered around a natural occurrence of toxic gases stemming from the core of [FromFromFrom.GetName]. Readjusting the facility somewhat should allow us to harvest these for ourselves.

variants.zh: 它引导着我们来到了远远深于地表之处，在那里我们遇到了一台规模大到难以置信的机器，很有可能是用于稳定[FromFromFrom.GetName]，但是现在已经损毁过重无法修复。尽管无法修整，这台处于损伤状态的机器能够产出某几种有毒气体，或许能对我们派上用场。
variants.en: It led further below the surface where we came across a machine of incredible proportions, probably once used to stabilize [FromFromFrom.GetName], but now damaged beyond repair. Though unsalvageable, the machine's damaged state has led to the creation of several toxic gases that we might make use of.

variants.zh: 随着我们跟上脚步，我们在地表的下面发现了泽珞的源头。来自外星文明的采集工具在房室的走廊上四散摆放，只要施加一点才智我们应该就能亲自使用这些工具。
variants.en: As we continued to follow it, we found a source of zro buried deep below the surface. Exotic harvesting tools littered the chamber floor, and with a little ingenuity we should be able to make use of them ourselves.

variants.zh: 它同一个埋藏在地表深处、已经不再运转的设施连接在一起。这个设施本身看上去似乎是打算调查一个泽珞的撞击点。尽管内部空空，绝大多数功能已经下线，将此地再次使用起来满足我们自己的目的应该是可行的。
variants.en: It is connected to a defunct facility hidden in the depths below. The facility itself appears intended to survey a zro impact site. Though empty and largely offline, it should eventually be possible to reuse it for our own purposes.

variants.zh: 通过某种复杂的过程，它似乎同一个研究无人机连接在了一起。这个无人机环绕着一个深埋于行星地表之下的微小黑洞，可能是在研究这个黑洞的过程中不知通过什么方式稳定了它的奇点。尽管我们无法重现这项技术上的壮举，但我们可以充分利用这个无人机为己所用。
variants.en: Through a complex process, it seems to be attached to a research drone. Circling a micro black hole located far below the planet's surface the drone has somehow managed to stabilize the singularity, perhaps in an effort to research it. Though we are unable to replicate this technological feat, we should be able to utilize the drone for our own means.

variants.zh: 我们发现它引向了一个远在地表之下的房室。在那里我们看到活体金属和某个我们认为过去是软体类的生物，以一种令人瞠目结舌的方式聚结在了一起。这两种事物已经融合在了一起，沿着地底下的洞穴网络慢慢地向外延伸。通过一定的努力，我们或许可以在不对这个生物造成太大伤害的前提下，小心地凿落一些金属的碎片。
variants.en: We have discovered that it leads to a chamber further below the surface. There we chanced upon a beguiling amalgamation of living metal and what we believe was once a molluscoid creature. It seems the two have fused together, slowly expanding through the cavern networks below the ground. With some effort, we should be able to start chipping pieces off the metal, for our own uses, without doing the creature too much harm.

variants.zh: 我们没有花太多功夫，就发现活体金属集中在一个狭窄的人工房室中。由于它会滑动，并且对触碰能够产生反应，我们相信它的生命程度比我们一开始料想得要更高。如果我们对它小心地收集，我们能够在不杀死这个生物的前提下，最大程度地利用它。
variants.en: It didn't take long for us to find the living metal is centered on a narrow grotto. As it slithers and reacts to touch, we believe it might be more alive than one might first think. If we harvest it carefully, we should be able to maximize our use of the creature, without killing it.

variants.zh: 为了诱使他们多留几年，我们得给予一些激励。不要小看蝇头小利的力量。
variants.en: To entice them to stay on a few more years, we might offer an incentive. Never underestimate the power of a well-placed bribe.

variants.zh: 我们可以提醒他们这里乐趣多多，或许可以提供一些具体的例子来鼓励他们留下来。
variants.en: We could remind them of the many pleasures here, and perhaps provide a few discrete examples as an incentive to stay.

variants.zh: 好吧，如果他们坚持要回家的话我们也别无选择，只能告知他们的政府他们参与了违法的异星关系。
variants.en: Well, if they insist on returning home, we have no choice but to inform their government about the illicit xeno-relations they were engaging in.

variants.zh: 我们可以预留政府津贴来资助这个项目。这应该能让他们分心一段时间。
variants.en: We could set aside a government stipend to fund this project. That should keep them distracted for a while longer.

variants.zh: 都说集思广益，我看你们这个“集”也没能“思”个什么东西出来。
variants.en: Many minds supposedly make light work, but your collective intelligence has amounted to precious little.

variants.zh: 你们这些大只裸猿出发来太空旅游的时候是不是忘记把脑子带上了。
variants.en: You thick-boned smooth-skins have developed interstellar travel yet common sense continues to elude you.

variants.zh: 你们这群蠢兽比起我们伟大领袖的智慧和修养可是天差地别。
variants.en: Beasts such as yourselves lack the intellect and refinement of our great leader.

variants.zh: 虽然我一开始就没指望你们这群四脚蛇搞懂这种基本的概念。
variants.en: Although, I would never expect you simple newts to understand such basic concepts as this.

variants.zh: 可能你们的老祖宗啄树的时候把脑子给震坏了吧。
variants.en: Perhaps your ancestors took one too many pecks to the cranium.

variants.zh: 你们的外骨骼一开始就忘记把批判性思维的能力给包进去我是一点也不意外。
variants.en: I am unsurprised that the ability to think critically has not penetrated your species' thick exoskeleton.

variants.zh: 据说鼻涕虫是没有脑子的，看到你们以后我就知道这是真的了。
variants.en: It is a fact that molluscs have no recognizable brain. Your species is evidence of that.

variants.zh: 你们看起来像是一把连蘑菇都长不明白的孢子。
variants.en: You seem to be a few spores short of a mushroom.

variants.zh: 我看了你们以后是越来越明白为什么别的星球上的植物都不发展出智能了。
variants.en: It is becoming increasingly obvious why plants have not developed intelligence on the majority of worlds.

variants.zh: 你们真是蠢得和石头一样。
variants.en: Your species truly is dumb as rocks.

variants.zh: 你们可能复活的时候把智力给落下了。
variants.en: You must be the husks of what once was an intelligent species.

variants.zh: 你们的鱼脑离开了水就窒息了是吧。
variants.en: You are clearly a fish out of water here.
An existence basking in filth has perhaps clouded your minds.

variants.zh: 看来人格矩阵把你们的算力都给用完了。
variants.en: Perhaps your individuality modules consume the majority of your processing power.

default.zh: 你们物种智力方面的灾难就跟你们的外貌一样惨烈。
default.en: Perhaps your species is as intellectually challenged as it is horribly disfigured.

Whenever it flourishes, life is fleeting.
Wherever they grow, the living are fragile.

variants.zh: 心如泉水，思绪流过时空。我们汇入了另一个维度。
variants.en: The mind is a spring, and thought flows through time and space. We drain into other dimensions.

variants.zh: 一切果皆可由因循见。顺因缘而下便可知其果报。
variants.en: The effect of any cause can be foreseen. To know the fate of things, one need only predict the lines.

variants.zh: 恒星燃尽的一刻将亮过整个星河。万物亦然，终归于无。
variants.en: At death, stars can shine brighter than galaxies. These things, too, shall fade.

variants.zh: 星系聚处混沌称王。太虚却允诺着平和。
variants.en: Chaos reigns where galaxies cluster. The void is a promise of calm.
A bridge can collapse any distance, and any bridge can be collapsed.
Every push is married to a pull.

variants.zh:
星辰燃为烬，烬粉聚作云。
云中生银汉，银汉不异尘。
variants.en:
A star dies, shedding dust; the dust forms a cloud.
From the cloud, a star is formed; the star's fate is dust.

variants.zh: 未知催人探索，探索却使人盲目。
variants.en: Explorers seek unknowns; exploration then blinds them.

variants.zh: 内容之物无人晓，潜身其中不可回。
variants.en: What lies within cannot be known. To dive within means no escape.

variants.zh: 运动之物选择停下。那么代价是什么呢？
variants.en: An object in motion chooses to rest. What should be its punishment?
Truth is in the depths below.

variants.zh: 而在虚境之中，生死皆为无相。
variants.en: In the Shroud, there will be no life or death.

variants.zh: 我们的存在将超越生命。

variants.en: We trace these lines in dreams.
Death will no longer concern us.

variants.zh: 我们向往彼岸之景跨过这座桥。
variants.en: We cross to reach the other side.
This is what makes us precious.
We are yet to be born.
All things die. Few things live.
We must first live before we can die.

variants.zh: 我们怀抱回归之愿跨过这座桥。
variants.en: We cross in hope of return.

variants.zh: 在此，电路运行不受物理因素的阻碍。虚境能够以超越传统参数的方式优化我们的处理器。
variants.en: Here, circuitry runs unimpeded by physical factors. The Shroud is able to optimize our processors in ways beyond our conventional parameters.

default.zh: 在此，血肉如思绪一般狂放不羁，虚境能以远超我们的能力重塑我们。
default.en: Here, flesh roams as freely as thought, allowing the Shroud to remake us beyond our means.

variants.zh: 在此，过分的渴求被囤积、净化和重新分配，促进我们集体的稳定。
variants.en: Here, excesses are hoarded, sanitized, and redistributed to promote the stability of our collective.

default.zh: 在此，财富被囤积起来，又在消费狂热中散尽，这让我们离满足更近了一步。
default.en: Here, riches are hoarded then traded away in a consumptive frenzy that brings us no closer to fulfillment.

variants.zh: 在此，秘密交换以神秘，新知得以封存，我们的信号汇入了合唱。
variants.en: Here, secrets are traded in cryptic exchanges, new knowledge is brought to be sealed away, and our signals join the chorus.

default.zh: 在此，秘密交换以耳语，新知得以封存，我们的低吟汇入了合唱。
default.en: Here, secrets are traded in hushed tones, new knowledge is brought to be sealed away, and our murmurs join the chorus.

variants.zh: 在这里，人们汇聚一堂，共同理解我们和平超主的异世之志。
variants.en: Here, minds meet to comprehend the foreign will of our peace-nurturing patron.

default.zh: 在这里，人们汇聚一堂培植平静，塑造着跨星系合作。
default.en: Here, calm is cultivated by the meeting of minds, fostering intragalactic cooperation.

variants.en: The survey team found a weakness in the seal and broke through, at which point the ringing became deafening, causing sensory overload and cognitive breakdown among drones.

default.en: The survey team found a weakness in the seal and broke through, at which point the ringing became deafening, causing panic attacks and fits of rage among the team.

variants.zh: 投资行星保护工作将起到应对波动的保障作用，有助巩固资产基础。但若我们转而选择利用增强的辐射，或许能够提升能源和工业指标。
variants.en: An investment in planetary protection would act as insurance against volatility, and would help secure our asset base. But we might be able to boost our energy and industrial metrics if we pivot to harnessing the increased radiation instead.

default.zh: 防护恒星辐射可为我们争取更多时间。另一种方案更危险但潜力可观，即利用增强的辐射，提升能源和工业产能。
default.en: Protecting against stellar radiation can buy us more time. A more hazardous but potentially lucrative scheme would be to harness the increased radiation, boosting our energy and industrial sectors.

variants.zh: 我们的母星如今成了遍布星系的矿藏宝库，资源散布广泛，极易开采。相较于深埋于行星或卫星内部时，这些资源现在的开采成本大幅降低。凭借这条低成本的资源供应链，我们的利润有望迎来飙升。
variants.en: Our homeworld has been converted into a vast field of mineral wealth, spread across the system for convenient access. The cost of mining these resources is far less than it would have been if they had remained inside their respective planets and moons. We can expect our profits to soar thanks to this cheap supply of resources.

default.zh: 尽管母星如今已经荒芜，但新星的爆发将整个恒星系中丰富的矿藏资源暴露出来。这些资源可以通过常规开采设备轻松获取。我们将凭借这笔财富，建设崭新的未来。
default.en: While our homeworld is now a wasteland, the nova exposed a treasure trove of mineral resources across the entire system that can be easily accessed by conventional mining equipment. This wealth can be used to build a new future.

variants.zh: 既然开采站已经消失，§Y[event_target:red_giant_homeworld_tmp.GetName]§!便可放下心来，这种事情永远不会再发生了。
variants.en: Since the station no longer exists, §Y[event_target:red_giant_homeworld_tmp.GetName]§! can rest easy knowing it can never happen again.

default.zh: 开采站闪烁着最后一次能量脉冲，随后完全停摆，只留下我们独自收拾母星的残骸。
default.en: The station flickers with one last pulse of energy before shutting down, leaving us alone to pick up the pieces of our homeworld.

variants.zh: 造成红巨星浩劫的缘由如今已无关紧要。我们能做的，只有接受既成事实，在废墟之上重建一切。
variants.en: Whatever caused the Red Giant calamity is no longer relevant, all we can do now is accept our current state and rebuild from what is left.

variants.zh:
恒星爆发造成的破坏抹去了追踪元凶所需的一切证据。

我们能做的，只有接受既成事实，在废墟之上重建一切。
variants.en:
Disruptions by the stellar blast wiped out any evidence needed to track the culprit down.

All we can do now is accept our current state and rebuild from what is left.

default.zh:
残余外星人在破败开采站启动的进程终于走向了终结：§Y[Target.GetStarName]§!发生新星爆发，几乎吞噬了整个恒星系。绚丽的等离子体与辐射将§Y[event_target:red_giant_homeworld_tmp.GetName]§!，连同整个母星系，彻底摧毁殆尽。

variants.zh:
我方[GetScientistPlural]分析曾点燃红巨星的§Y$entropy_crystals$§!，一度险毁文明。现已可被重新设计改造，使其适用于工业体系、经济结构以及恒星级能源运输。

模拟结果显示，此能量可用于环境改造行星气候，使其升温，甚至推动恒星向红巨星阶段演化。理论上，还可回收星系中逸散的熵能并转化为热量，进而恒星系推动热膨胀。

§H特殊项目立项：§!§Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!
variants.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] have analyzed the §Y$entropy_crystals$§! once used to ignite a Red Giant, an act that nearly ended our civilization before it began. We can now re-engineer this volatile substance to bind and transport vast thermal energy for industrial, economic, and stellar-scale use.

Simulations suggest it may enable terraforming into hotter climates or trigger stellar evolution into red giants. In theory, ambient galactic entropy could be reclaimed and converted into heat, driving systemic thermal expansion.

§HIssues Special Project:§! §Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!

default.zh:
我方[GetScientistPlural]报告发现一项全新技术，可将熵锁定于高能晶体阵列中储存。此§Y$entropy_crystals$§!可存运大量热能，适用于工业、经济与星际用途。

模拟结果表明，此能量可用于环境改造行星气候，使其升温，甚至推动恒星向红巨星阶段演化。理论上，还可回收星系中逸散的熵能并转化为热量，进而系统推动全星系热膨胀。

§H特殊项目立项：§!§Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!
default.en:
Our [GetScientistPlural] report a novel method for harvesting and storing entropy by binding it into a high-energy crystalline matrix. This §Y$entropy_crystals$§! can store and transport substantial thermal energy, applicable across industrial, economic, and interstellar operations.

Modeling suggests that it might be used to terraform planets into hotter climates, or even in accelerating stellar evolution into red giants. In principle, stray entropy from across the galaxy could be reclaimed and converted into usable heat, driving compounding thermal expansion on a galactic scale.

§HIssues Special Project:§! §Y$INF_CRISIS_ENTROPY$§!

variants.zh: §L“我们需要你在武装冲突解决方面的专业知识。”§!
variants.en: §L"We require your expertise in armed conflict resolution."§!
§L"Our minds may not be one, but our purpose unites us."§!

variants.zh: §L“欢迎登舰！愿胜利与我们同在。”§!
variants.en: §L"Welcome aboard! May victory be with us."§!

default.zh: §L“我们由衷感谢你们提供的军事援助。”§!
default.en: §L"We are grateful for your military support."§!

variants.en: §L"The collective is preoccupied with internal matters."§!

variants.zh: §L“一个利润丰厚的劫掠机会，机不可失，时不再来！”§!

default.zh: §L“去掠袭他们，但别告诉他们是我们让你这么做的。”§!
default.en: §L"Raid them, but don't tell them we told you to do it."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们作为一个整体，感谢你提供的力量。”§!
variants.en: §L"As one, we thank you for your strength."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们投资战争技术实乃明智之举。”§!
variants.en: §L"We were wise to invest in warfare technology."§!

default.en: §L"Thank you. It had to be done."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们作为一个整体，深表失望。”§!
§L“唉，神明必将降罪于他们。还有你。”§!
variants.en: §L"Alas, the deities will smite them. And you."§!

variants.zh: §L“你毫无诚信，这将导致你的毁灭。”§!
variants.en: §L"You have no integrity. It will be your downfall."§!

default.zh: §L“任务失败！我们会联系其他劫掠者。”§!
default.en: §L"The mission is a failure! We will contact other raiders."§!

variants.en: §L"The collective calls upon your engineering skill."§!

variants.zh: §L“兴建一座配得上神明的巨型结构！”§!
variants.en: §L"Erect a megastructure worthy of the deities!"§!

variants.zh: §L“请接受这份令人振奋的建筑合同！”§!

default.zh: §L“带上你的方舟舰和你最优秀的工程师。”§!
default.en: §L"Bring your Arkship and your best engineers."§!

variants.zh: §L“你帮助了我们。作为一个整体，我们心存感激。”§!
variants.en: §L"You have helped us. As one, we are grateful."§!

variants.zh: §L“愿福佑于你，亦于我们的新巨型结构。”§!
variants.en: §L"Blessings upon you, and upon our new megastructure."§!

variants.zh: §L“太棒了！你的工作完成得非常出色！”§!
variants.en: §L"Superb! Well done for hitting your deliverables!"§!

default.zh: §L“这是一座令人印象深刻的建筑。你做得很好。”§!
default.en: §L"It is an impressive structure. You have done well."§!

variants.zh: §L“[GetBrainName]真的很想建成那个巨型结构……”§!
§L“由于缺乏巨型结构，我们的精神世界变得萎靡不振。”§!
variants.en: §L"Our spirits are dampened by the lack of megastructure."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们投资了你，而你没能达到预期。”§!
variants.en: §L"We invested in you, and you failed to deliver."§!

default.zh: §L“所以呢？我们还得自己把它造出来？”§!
default.en: §L"So, what? We're just supposed to build it ourselves?"§!

variants.zh: §L“我们寻求与群星之间的手足同胞进行交流。”§!
variants.en: §L"We seek communion with our stellar siblings."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们的结合得到了神明的祝福。”§!
variants.en: §L"Our communion was blessed by the deities."§!

variants.zh: §L“感谢您照顾我们的利益相关者。”§!
variants.en: §L"Thank you for taking care of our stakeholders."§!

default.zh: §L“代表们已安全送达。你应该认真考虑将星系出租车司机作为你的职业生涯。”§!
default.en: §L"The delegates have been safely delivered. You should consider a job with Galactic Taxis."§!

variants.zh: §L“是灵体抛弃了我们，还是你辜负了我们？”§!
variants.en: §L"Have the spirits failed us, or have you?"§!
§L"If you're on time, you're late. Learn to grind."§!
§L"Initiate scanning. Report back with your findings."§!

variants.zh: §L“太可惜了，它们被毁掉了。在此表示哀悼与祈祷。”§!
variants.en: §L"Such a pity they were destroyed. Thoughts and prayers."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们需要出于保险目的进行独立评估。”§!
variants.en: §L"We require an independent assessment for insurance purposes."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们太忙了，以至于无暇扫描身后留下的残骸。”§!
variants.en: §L"We are too busy to scan the wreckage we leave in our wake."§!

variants.zh: §L“他们现在可能在一个更好的地方。”§!
variants.en: §L"They're probably in a better place now."§!
§L"Good, yes. It seems the driver was at fault."§!

variants.zh: §L“如果我们还粉碎了其他任何敌人，我们会让你知道的。”§!
variants.en: §L"We will let you know if we pulverise anyone else."§!

default.zh: §L“很有趣！如果再次发生，我们会通知您的。”§!
default.en: §L"Interesting! We will let you know if it happens again."§!

variants.zh: §L“[GetBrainName] 尚未收到您的扫描结果。这不太理想。”§!
variants.en: §L"The [GetBrainName] has not received your scans. Sub-optimal."§!

variants.zh: §L“这让我们感到悲伤。我们对你的信心已经减少了。”§!
variants.en: §L"This saddens us. Our faith in you has diminished."§!

variants.zh: §L“没扫描？这简直是情感上坐了个过山车。我们要起诉你方！”§!
variants.en: §L"No scan? This is emotional whiplash. We'll sue!"§!

variants.zh: §L“别再让我们失望了，否则下次留下的就会是你自己的残骸。”§!
variants.en: §L"Don't fail us again, or next time it will be your own wreckage."§!

default.zh: §L“别再让我们失望了，否则下次留下的就会是你自己的残骸。”§!
default.en: §L"Don't fail us again, or next time it will be your own wreckage."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们祈请您能协助我们清理这些地表障碍。”§!
variants.en: §L"We pray you can assist us with these obstacles."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们常用的地面清理公司已经约满了。”§!
variants.en: §L"Our usual removals company is fully booked."§!

default.zh: §L“我们将不胜感激您的行星工程造诣。”§!
default.en: §L"We would appreciate your planetary engineering prowess."§!

variants.zh: §L“感谢你为集体清除了这些地表障碍。”§!
variants.en: §L"You have the collective's thanks for removing these obstacles."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们的祈祷得到了回应。我们不再受阻。”§!
variants.en: §L"Our prayers are answered. We are blocked no more."§!

variants.zh: §L“高效清除。五星好评。会再次聘用。”§!
variants.en: §L"Efficient removal. Five stars. Would hire again."§!

default.zh: §L“好多了。我们现在有空间扩建了。”§!
default.en: §L"Much better. We now have space to expand."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们依然受阻。我们会为你祈祷。”§!
variants.en: §L"We remain blocked. We will pray for you."§!

variants.zh: §L“请勿就移除费用向我方开具发票。此类发票将被忽略。”§!
variants.en: §L"Do not invoice us for removals. It will be ignored."§!

default.zh: §L“我们会告诉熟人，在园林绿化方面你并不可靠。”§!
default.en: §L"We will tell our acquaintances that you are unreliable when it comes to landscaping."§!

variants.zh: §L“建立一座驿站，引导朝圣者走向我们。”§!
variants.en: §L"Build a Waystation to guide pilgrims to us."§!
§L"We want to bring in more trade."§!

default.zh: §L“请帮助我们连接到星系贸易路线。”§!
default.en: §L"Help us connect to galactic trade routes."§!

variants.zh: §L“太棒了。这将使我们更接近神性。”§!
variants.en: §L"Wonderful. This will bring us closer to the divine."§!
§L"This will do wonders for the economy."§!

default.zh: §L“星系现在感觉变小了，是以一种好的方式。”§!
default.en: §L"The galaxy feels smaller now, in a good way."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们渴望连结。我们却一无所获。”§!
variants.en: §L"We wished for connection. We have received nothing."§!

variants.zh: §L“朝圣者现在该如何找到自己的道路？”§!
variants.en: §L"How will pilgrims find their way now?"§!

variants.zh: §L“你今天树立了一个经济上的对手。当心点。”§!
variants.en: §L"You have made an economic rival today. Watch out."§!

default.zh: §L“你是觉得我们不配拥有一个驿站吗？”§!
default.en: §L"Do you think us unworthy of a Waystation?"§!

variants.zh: §L“这些兽群正在干扰集体的计划。”§!
variants.en: §L"These fauna are interfering with the collective's plans."§!

variants.zh: §L“这些不敬神灵的畜生正在亵渎它们栖息的空间。”§!
variants.en: §L"These ungodly critters are desecrating the space they inhabit."§!

default.en: §L"Kill these pests, please and thank you."§!

variants.zh: §L“[GetBrainName]对你干脆果断的行动表示感激。”§!
variants.en: §L"The [GetBrainName] is thankful for your swift action."§!
§L"Glory to you, the eradicator of pests."§!

variants.zh: §L“太棒了！现在我们可以把害虫入侵免责声明去掉了。”§!
variants.en: §L"Brilliant! Now we can drop the infestation disclaimer."§!

default.en: §L"Ah, the system is much safer now."§!

variants.zh: §L“缺乏害虫防治的情况，这并不理想。”§!
variants.en: §L"The lack of pest control is sub-optimal."§!

variants.zh: §L“闹事的兽群是神圣的对立面。”§!
variants.en: §L"Hostile fauna is the antithesis of holiness."§!

variants.zh: §L“对于由太空兽群造成的任何损害，我们概不负责。”§!
variants.en: §L"We will not accept liability for any damage caused by space fauna."§!

variants.zh: §L“为什么你除掉这些病害就这么难？”§!
variants.en: §L"Why is it so hard for you to destroy vermin?"§!

default.en: §L"The pests are still there! This is unacceptable."§!

variants.zh: §L“带领这些朝圣者踏上一场升天之旅。”§!
variants.en: §L"Take these pilgrims on a celestial tour."§!

variants.zh: §L“太空旅游是一个蓬勃发展的市场！”§!

default.zh: §L“我们有想要观光游览的游客！”§!
default.en: §L"We have tourists who wish to see the sights!"§!

variants.zh: §L“观光旅游是一项有利可图的事业！”§!
§L“他们所求的不过是窥见神迹。”§!
variants.en: §L"All they wanted was a glimpse of the divine."§!

variants.zh: §L“指引我们的信徒，在这片神圣的土地上安顿下来。”§!
variants.en: §L"Guide our faithful as they settle this sacred ground."§!

variants.zh: §L“这个殖民地是极佳的投资机会！”§!
variants.en: §L"This colony is a prime investment opportunity!"§!

variants.zh: §L“加固这个前哨站。它必须处于随时待战的状态。”§!
variants.en: §L"Fortify this outpost. It must be battle-ready."§!

variants.zh: §L“此物理站点需要优化。请协助初始化。”§!
variants.en: §L"This physical site requires optimization. Assist with initialization."§!

default.en: §L"Our new colony needs a helping hand."§!

variants.zh: §L“神灵眷顾我们的新家。祝福你。”§!
variants.en: §L"The deities smile upon our new home. Bless you."§!

variants.zh: §L“稳固的据点。这块殖民地将坚守阵线。”§!
variants.en: §L"A strong foothold. This colony will hold the line."§!

variants.zh: §L“物理站点已运行。您的贡献已记录。”§!
variants.en: §L"Physical site operational. Your contribution has been logged."§!

default.zh: §L“殖民地目前正处于良好的发展趋势上。”§!
default.en: §L"The colony is now on a good path."§!

variants.zh: §L“孤立无援的挣扎会使虔诚者更加强大。”§!
variants.en: §L"Struggling without help will make the faithful stronger."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们预期的增长数据全毁了。”§!
§L“没有防御工事的殖民地是一种累赘。”§!
§L“初始化不完整。效率受到影响。”§!

default.zh: §L“我们的殖民者必须自力更生。”§!
default.en: §L"Our colonists will have to manage on their own."§!

variants.zh: §L“神圣的火花在那沉睡的巨人体内等待。唤醒它。”§!
variants.en: §L"The divine spark awaits within that slumbering giant. Awaken it."§!

variants.zh: §L“第二颗恒星的预期投资回报率是天文数字。”§!
variants.en: §L"The projected ROI on a second star is astronomical."§!

variants.zh: §L“一颗新星意味着对该星区的战略主导权。去办吧。”§!
variants.en: §L"A new star means strategic dominance over this sector. Make it happen."§!

variants.zh: §L“气态巨行星聚变概率：可行。启动恒星点火序列。”§!
variants.en: §L"Gas giant fusion probability: viable. Initiate stellar ignition sequence."§!

default.zh: §L“我们有一颗随时可以点燃的气态巨行星。带上你的$sm_arkship_stellar_igniter$。”§!
default.en: §L"We have a gas giant ripe for ignition. Bring your $sm_arkship_stellar_igniter$."§!

variants.zh: §L“两个太阳，双倍的游客。预订观光游轮吧！”§!
variants.en: §L"Two suns, twice the tourists. Book the sightseeing cruises!"§!

variants.zh: §L“一整颗仅凭纯粹意志铸就的恒星。”§!
variants.en: §L"An entire star forged by sheer force of will."§!

variants.zh: §L“恒星点火成功。能量输出在预期参数范围内。”§!
variants.en: §L"Stellar ignition successful. Energy output within projected parameters."§!

default.zh: §L“曾经只有气体与暗影的地方，如今闪耀着一颗新太阳。令人惊叹。”§!
default.en: §L"A new sun blazes where once there was only gas and shadow. Remarkable."§!

variants.zh: §L“天火仍未点燃。也许是我们不配。”§!
variants.en: §L"The celestial fire remains unlit. Perhaps we were unworthy."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们向利益相关者承诺过一颗星星。这是无法接受的。”§!
variants.en: §L"Our stakeholders were promised a star. This is unacceptable."§!

variants.zh: §L“如果再有一颗恒星，这个恒星系会更具战略价值。”§!
variants.en: §L"This system would be more strategically valuable with another star."§!

variants.zh: §L“行星点火程序中止。未达到聚变阈值。”§!
variants.en: §L"Ignition sequence aborted. Fusion threshold not achieved."§!

default.zh: §L“气态巨行星依然寒冷而黑暗。错失良机。”§!
default.en: §L"The gas giant remains cold and dark. A missed opportunity."§!

variants.zh: 各层甲板上的子个体将化身为来自下方星球的叛逃者，在完美的协同下，向不同的乘客群体同时提供机密简报。
variants.en: Drones across every deck will adopt defector personas from the planet below, delivering parallel clandestine briefings to different passenger groups in perfect coordination.

default.zh: 我们正在策划一场全舰范围的情报行动。船员志愿者将被安插在各个甲板上，作为“叛逃者”向乘客小组输送机密简报。
default.en: We are staging a ship-wide intelligence operation. Crew volunteers will be planted across all decks as 'defectors' feeding classified briefings to passenger cells.

variants.zh: 长期封闭正在削弱子个体的适应性。让它们在下方的定居点轮转，穿越陌生的地形与环境，将能恢复其性能。
variants.en: Prolonged confinement is degrading drone adaptability. Cycling them through the settlement below, across unfamiliar terrain and conditions, will restore performance.

default.zh: 船员们需要休息。我们将停靠港口，给船员们一些时间去踏上并非他们亲手建造的土地，去见见他们还不认识的面孔。
default.en: The crew needs a break. We'll make port and and give the crew time to walk ground they didn't build and see faces they don't already know.

variants.zh: §L“子个体正在部署至地表。新的地形，新的刺激，新的数据。飞船无法提供陌生土地所能给予的一切。”§!
variants.en: §L"Drones deploying to the surface. New terrain, new stimuli, new data. The ship cannot provide what unfamiliar ground can."§!

default.zh: §L‘新土地、新面孔，还没有值勤表。你还有什么不满意的呢？’§!
default.en: §L"New ground, new faces, and no duty roster. What more could you want?"§!

variants.zh: §L“子个体已重新校准并返回。陌生的地形恢复了曾被飞船走廊磨钝的路径。”§!
variants.en: §L"Drones returned recalibrated. Foreign terrain has restored pathways that the ship's corridors had dulled."§!

default.zh: §L‘重力不太对劲，食物也很奇怪。我迫不及待要回船上去了！’§!
default.en: §L"The gravity was wrong and the food was strange. I can't wait to go back!"§!

variants.zh: §L“靠岸部署已取消。子个体将继续基于过时感知运行。性能衰减仍处于可接受范围内。”§!
variants.en: §L"Shore deployment cancelled. Drones will continue operating on outdated awareness. Performance degradation remains within acceptable margins."§!

default.zh: §L‘岸上休假取消了。飞船一如既往地嗡嗡作响。这声音还是一如既往的令人安心。’§!
default.en: §L"Shore leave cancelled. The ship hums the same as always. It used to be comforting."§!

variants.zh: 定居点的娱乐区提供了从未体验过的刺激。子个体穿梭于人群、游戏和盛况之中，收集数据以更新飞船自身的娱乐程序。
variants.en: The settlement's entertainment district offers unfamiliar stimuli. Drones are cycling through the crowds, the games, the spectacle, collecting data to update the ship's own recreational programming.

default.zh: 当地娱乐区现已营业。船员们正轮班登陆星球，在游戏厅和竞技场里碰碰运气。
default.en: The local entertainment district is open for business. Crew shifts are rotating planetside to try their luck at game halls and spectator arenas.

variants.zh: §L“子个体正部署至娱乐区。目标：吸收一切。人群、游戏、噪音。所有的一切。”§!
variants.en: §L"Drones deploying to the entertainment district. Objective: absorb everything. The crowds, the games, the noise. All of it."§!

default.zh: §L“我已经攒了六个周期的轮班工资。今晚，我要把它们押在赌桌上狠狠梭哈一把。”§!
default.en: §L"I have been saving my shift wages for six cycles. Tonight, they all go on the table."§!

variants.zh: §L“子个体已满载全新节目返回。舰载娱乐系统正在更新。乘客们将会注意到其中的不同。”§!
variants.en: §L"Drones returned loaded with new patterns. Onboard recreational systems already updating. The passengers will notice the difference."§!

default.zh: §L“我在第一个小时就输光了一切，但在最后一局全赢了回来。我们整个班组的人把我抬了出去。”§!
default.en: §L"I lost everything in the first hour and won it all back on the last game. My whole shift carried me out."§!

variants.zh: §L“未收集到新数据。舰载娱乐系统继续运行着相同的节目。乘客们变得焦躁不安。”§!
variants.en: §L"No new data collected. Onboard entertainment continues running the same patterns. The passengers grow restless."§!

default.zh: §L“没有好运。又回到了同一个娱乐室，同一台动过手脚的抓娃娃机，还有同样的没人想要的奖品。”§!
default.en: §L"No lucky break. Back to the same rec room, the same rigged claw machine, the same prizes nobody wants."§!

variants.zh: §L“需求清单上一半是结构组件。另一半是我们三个周期前就耗尽的底盘润滑油。”§!
variants.en: §L"Half the requisition list is structural components. The other half is chassis lubricant we depleted three cycles ago."§!

default.zh: §L“物资申请单上一半是备件。另一半是我们自从上次靠港以来就没吃过的零食。”§!
default.en: §L"Half the requisition list is spare parts. The other half is snacks we have not had since the last port."§!

variants.zh: §L“我们征收电容器，还带回了多余的处理核心。效率提升：出乎意料但大有裨益。”§!
variants.en: §L"We requisitioned capacitors and returned with surplus processing cores. Efficiency gain: unexpected but advantageous."§!

default.zh: §L“我们为电容器而来，却带走了成箱的不明糖果。行吧，就当作是任务完成了。”§!
default.en: §L"We came for capacitors and left with crates of unidentified confectionery. Mission accomplished."§!

variants.zh: §L“他们的反应堆设计与我们数据库中的任何现有型号都不匹配。正在部署子个体直接对其进行检查。”§!
variants.en: §L"Their reactor design does not match any existing model in our database. Deploying drones to examine it directly."§!

default.zh: §L“他们的反应堆设计让我完全摸不着头脑。我必须亲自去看看。”§!
default.en: §L"Their reactor design makes no sense to me. I have to see it in person."§!

variants.zh: §L“外星工程解决方案已归档。数项设计已被标记为待整合。他们的方法虽然粗糙，却出人意料地有效。”§!
variants.en: §L"Alien engineering approaches catalogued. Several designs flagged for integration. Their methods are crude but surprisingly effective."§!

default.zh: §L“按我们的标准来看，他们的电网简直一团糟，但它确实能运作。我记了三页的笔记，对地面工程也有了全新的敬意。”§!
default.en: §L"Their power grid is a mess by our standards, but it works. I have three pages of notes and a new respect for dirt-side engineering."§!

variants.zh: §L“未进行交换。外星工程学仍未得到解析。他们的反应堆冷却方法只能以后再说了。”§!
variants.en: §L"No exchange conducted. Alien engineering remains unanalyzed. Their reactor cooling methods will have to wait."§!

default.zh: §L“没有技术交换。我只好继续好奇他们是如何在没有恒星散热器的情况下冷却反应堆的。”§!
default.en: §L"No tech exchange. I will just have to keep wondering how they cool their reactors without a stellar heat sink."§!

variants.zh: 定居点已开放其公共场所。子个体将会部署出动，在向乘客推出之前，先在当地居民身上实地测试实验性的娱乐程序。
variants.en: The settlement has opened its public venues. Drones will deploy to field-test experimental entertainment routines on the local population before rolling them out for passengers.

default.zh: 定居点已向船员开放其露天剧场、广场和公共舞台。
default.en: The settlement has opened its amphitheaters, plazas, and public stages to the crew.

variants.zh: §L“娱乐子程序已部署至所有定居点场所。喜剧模块：有铺垫无包袱。杂技模块：落地动作被设定为必然失败。观众监控已激活。”§!
variants.en: §L"Entertainment subroutines deployed across all settlement venues. Comedy modules: setups without punchlines. Acrobatics modules: dismounts calibrated to fail. Audience monitoring active."§!

variants.zh: §L“工蜂占据了定居点的每一个舞台。没有笑点的喜剧，故意演砸的杂技。我们想看看是什么能让他们发笑，又是什么会让他们离场。”§!
variants.en: §L"Drones are taking every stage in the settlement. Comedy with no punchlines, acrobatics designed to fail. We want to see what makes them laugh and what makes them leave."§!

default.zh: §L“我报名了喜剧表演。我们整个班次的同事都会来。如果他们不笑，我就申请调换部门。”§!
default.en: §L"I signed up for the comedy slot. My entire shift is coming. If they do not laugh, I will transfer departments."§!

variants.zh: §L“令人费解的结果。子个体表演了没有笑点的段子，观众却依然大笑。搞砸的杂技引来了最热烈的欢呼声。我们尚未完全理解，但采集到的数据很丰富。”§!
variants.en: §L"Puzzling results. Drones delivered routines with no punchlines and the crowds laughed anyway. The botched acrobatics drew the loudest cheers. We do not fully understand, but the data is dynamic."§!

default.zh: §L“我讲了个关于冷却泵的笑话，有一千个陌生人笑了。飞船上可从来没人觉得这个笑话好笑。”§!
default.en: §L"I told a joke about the coolant pumps and a thousand strangers laughed. Nobody on the ship ever laughs at that one."§!

variants.zh: §L“没有实地测试。我们的子个体在整个聚居地的空荡平台上待命。乘客们将在又一个周期中继续忍受那令人厌倦的枯燥日常。”§!
variants.en: §L"No field test. Our drones stood ready on empty stages across the settlement. The passengers will endure the same tired routines for another cycle."§!

default.zh: §L“演出取消了。我为我的戏份排练了一个月。冷却泵永远也得不到它们应有的认可。”§!
default.en: §L"Show cancelled. I rehearsed my bit for a month. The coolant pumps will never get the recognition they deserve."§!

variants.zh: §L“维护已推迟。发电机持续老化。故障时间线已重新计算。”§!
variants.en: §L"Maintenance postponed. Generator degradation continues. Failure timeline recalculated."§!

default.zh: §L‘维护又推迟了。照这样下去，发电机都要自己安排停机了。’§!
default.en: §L"Maintenance postponed again. At this rate the generators will schedule their own shutdown."§!

variants.zh: §L“正在关闭舷窗。已告知乘客这是计划中的照明升级。”§!
variants.en: §L"Shuttering viewports. Passengers have been informed it is a scheduled lighting upgrade."§!

default.zh: §L“现在关闭舷窗。如果有人问起，记得告诉乘客这是计划中的照明升级。”§!
default.en: §L"Shuttering the viewports now. If anyone asks, remember to tell the passengers it is a scheduled lighting upgrade."§!

variants.zh: §L“所有面板均在容差范围内。舰体破损概率在接下来的一个周期内已降低。”§!
variants.en: §L"All panels within tolerance. Hull breach probability reduced for another cycle."§!

default.zh: §L“所有船体面板均在容差范围内。我们又有一个周期不必担心船体破裂了。”§!
default.en: §L"All panels within tolerance. That is another cycle we can skip worrying about a hull breach."§!

variants.zh: §L“重新校准已中止。舰体完整性评估为合格。监控继续。”§!
variants.en: §L"Recalibration aborted. Hull integrity rated adequate. Monitoring continues."§!

default.zh: §L“重新校准已中止。船体大抵应该是没问题的。”§!
default.en: §L"Recalibration aborted. The hull is probably fine."§!

variants.zh: §L“预计乘客甲板会出现温度波动。若被问起，将告知乘客这是环境氛围的一部分。”§!
variants.en: §L"Temperature fluctuations on passenger decks anticipated. If queried, passengers will be told it is part of the ambience."§!

default.zh: §L“乘客甲板会变热。然后变冷。接着又变热。告诉他们这就是环境氛围的一部分。”§!
default.en: §L"Passenger decks will get warm. Then cold. Then warm again. We just tell them it is part of the ambience."§!

variants.zh: §L“冲洗推迟。舞厅天花板正在形成冷凝水。不太可能引起乘客的注意。”§!
variants.en: §L"Flush postponed. Condensation forming on the ballroom ceiling. Unlikely to draw passenger attention."§!

default.zh: §L“冲洗已推迟。我们希望没人注意到舞厅天花板上正在形成的冷凝水。”§!
default.en: §L"Flush postponed. We hope that nobody notices the condensation forming on the ceiling of the ballroom."§!

variants.zh: §L“正将娱乐带宽重新分配至传感器网络。已预见并接受乘客的不满。”§!
variants.en: §L"Rerouting entertainment bandwidth to the sensor grid. Passenger dissatisfaction anticipated and accepted."§!

default.zh: §L“正在将娱乐带宽重定向至传感器网格。准备迎接乘客的投诉：三、二、一……”§!
default.en: §L"Rerouting entertainment bandwidth to the sensor grid. Expect passenger complaints in three, two, one..."§!

variants.zh: §L“校准未完成。导航数据降级。乘客娱乐带宽已恢复。”§!
variants.en: §L"Calibration incomplete. Navigation data degraded. Entertainment bandwidth restored to passengers."§!

default.zh: §L“校准未完成。导航数据依然模糊，但至少全息屏幕又亮了。”§!
default.en: §L"Calibration incomplete. The nav data is still fuzzy, but at least the holoscreens are back on."§!

variants.zh: §L“正在排空泳池和水疗池。已告知乘客今天是常规深度清洁日。细菌读数未公开。”§!
variants.en: §L"Draining the pool and spa. Passengers have been informed it is a routine deep-cleaning day. Bacterial readings withheld."§!

default.zh: §L“现在正在排空泳池和疗愈池。如果乘客问起，就说是深度清洁日。我们不要提及细菌读数。”§!
default.en: §L"Draining the pool and the spa now. If the passengers ask, it is a deep-cleaning day. We do not mention the bacteria readings."§!

variants.zh: §L“回收水箱已清空。水质正常。泳池与水疗池正在注水。”§!
variants.en: §L"Reclamation tanks clear. Water quality nominal. Pool and spa refill in progress."§!

default.zh: §L“回收槽已清理。水流已恢复清澈。在其他人提出正式投诉之前，正在为水池重新注水。”§!
default.en: §L"Reclamation tanks clear. Water is flowing clean again. Refilling the pool before anyone else files a formal grievance."§!

variants.zh: §L“消毒未完成。水质处于临界值。水疗中心关闭时间延长一个周期。”§!
variants.en: §L"Sterilization incomplete. Water quality marginal. Spa closure extended by one cycle."§!

default.zh: §L“消毒未完成。水质……还可以接受。水疗中心再关一天吧。”§!
default.en: §L"Sterilization incomplete. The water is... acceptable. Just keep the spa closed for another day."§!

variants.zh: 如果我们希望竞争市场东道主的头衔，可以在几年的时间里使用§H决议§!来提名我们的一个星球主持$galactic_market_station$。
variants.en: Should we desire to compete for the title of market host, we have a few years to use §HDecisions§! to nominate one of our worlds to tether the $galactic_market_station$.

variants.zh: 我们没有星球可以作为$galactic_market_station$的锚地，因此我们无法承担东道主之责。但无论该空间站选址何处，我们都可自由参与贸易。
variants.en: Our people have no world to offer as the $galactic_market_station$'s anchor, and so we cannot compete for the role of market host. We may yet trade freely through whichever port the station calls home.

default.zh: 如果我们希望竞争市场东道主的头衔，可以在几年的时间里使用§H决议§!来提名我们的一个星球主持$galactic_market_station$。
default.en: Should we desire to compete for the title of market host, we have a few years to use §HDecisions§! to nominate one of our worlds to tether the $galactic_market_station$.
